text: On the other hand, put at their head another stamp of general: one who is by right divine a leader, good and brave, a man of scientific knowledge. Let him take over to his charge those malcontents, or others even of worse character, and he will have them presently ashamed of doing a disgraceful deed. "It is nobler to obey" will be their maxim. They will exult in personal obedience and in common toil, where toil is needed, cheerily performed.
author: Xenophon
speaker: Ischomachus
